messages:
incidentbot: PagerDuty page fired for embedder-eu-queue (P1) — 120 queued requests, 5xx rate ↑, customer-facing latency spike. auto-info: alert_id=PD-8921 region=eu

maria (oncall): seeing the same in dashboards. Customers report 502s. Paging SREs.

jordan: I can take this. Oncall handover: migrating from maria to me. Starting investigation.

ben: tagging in case we need a quick pool reroute or dedicated burst. Any ETA on root cause?

jordan: initial guess kv-cache thrash + backpressure. Logs show heavy tailing requests from embed batch job.

ops-sre: incidentbot shows autoscaler didn't spawn extra workers — looks like scale blocked by quota on gcp-eu-1.
maria (oncall): noted. Jordan, if you want me to push the PD ack/ownership transfer, do it and I'll update customers.

jordan: claiming PD. @incidentbot transfer_ack to jordan confirmed. Acked on PagerDuty.

jordan: quick mitigation plan: 1) pause the large batch job 2) scale up dedicated-embed-eu pool 3) reroute new traffic to warm fallback nodes

maria (oncall): +1 for pausing the batch. Which job ID?
jordan: job id embed-batch-2026-03-17-17. Running: curl to control API ->
```
redwoodctl jobs pause embed-batch-2026-03-17-17
redwoodctl pool scale dedicated-embed-eu --replicas=6
```

ben: I'll open a quick quota increase with infra. If scaling fails, we have a fallback: route to eu-legacy-embed (slower but stable).

jordan: paused the job. redwoodctl returned OK. Scaling pool now...
jordan: scale response: accepted, new target replicas=6, rolling up.

ops-sre: infra ticket created #INF-1289 for quota bump, ETA ~10m.
maria (oncall): customer comms draft: "We've identified and mitigated elevated inference errors for EU customers; rolling fixes now, more updates in 10m." Approving and sending.

jordan: traffic reroute started to eu-legacy-embed for new requests. Observability shows queue draining, 5xxs decreasing. :thumbsup:

ben: nice. Any sign of persistent cache corruption or just load?
jordan: looks like request storm + cache eviction spike. We'll collect cache metrics and KV eviction traces for postmortem.

maria (oncall): status ping: current queue 18, 5xx rate back to baseline for most tenants, some lag for heavy customers.

incidentbot: PagerDuty update: incident acknowledged by jordan, responders notified, PD escalation paused.

jordan: I'll keep monitoring and hold the bridge until stable. If no regressions in 15m I'll hand back to maria and close PD.

maria (oncall): thanks — stand by for handback. Great coordination.

jordan: handing back to maria — will post final status before close.
maria (oncall): confirmed ownership transfer back to oncall. Preparing post-incident notes and next steps (rate-limit tuning, autoscaler fail-safes, better batch throttles).

ben: + postmortem please, include remediation: autoscaler healthchecks and quota pre-warm for big batches.

jordan: final: queue=6, 5xx stable, scale stable. Closing bridge in 5.

maria (oncall): incident closed from oncall side. Will file follow-up. Thanks everyone. :heart:
